description: Unit test class for MiniKeyboardActionListener, testing various keyboard interaction methods and their interactions with mocked dependencies.

classes.name: MiniKeyboardActionListenerTest
classes.description: Test suite for MiniKeyboardActionListener, verifying interaction with parent listener and dismiss action.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the object under test before each test case.

methods.name: testOnKey
methods.description: Verifies onKey method triggers correct parent listener call with specified key and nearby key codes.

methods.name: testOnKeyOnEnter
methods.description: Verifies onKey with ENTER key triggers parent listener and dismisses keyboard.

methods.name: testOnKeyOnShot
methods.description: Verifies one-shot key press triggers parent listener and dismisses keyboard.

methods.name: testOnKeyOnShotButDelete
methods.description: Verifies delete key in one-shot mode triggers parent listener without dismissing keyboard.

methods.name: testOnMultiTapStarted
methods.description: Verifies onMultiTapStarted calls parent listener.

methods.name: testOnMultiTapEnded
methods.description: Verifies onMultiTapEnded calls parent listener.

methods.name: testOnText
methods.description: Verifies onText triggers parent listener with given key and text.

methods.name: testOnTextOneShot
methods.description: Verifies onText in one-shot mode triggers parent listener and dismisses keyboard.

methods.name: testOnTyping
methods.description: Verifies onTyping triggers parent listener.

methods.name: testOnTypingOneShot
methods.description: Verifies onTyping in one-shot mode triggers parent listener and dismisses keyboard.

methods.name: testOnCancel
methods.description: Verifies onCancel triggers dismiss action.

methods.name: testOnSwipeLeft
methods.description: Verifies swipe left does not interact with parent or dismiss.

methods.name: testOnSwipeRight
methods.description: Verifies swipe right does not interact with parent or dismiss.

methods.name: testOnSwipeUp
methods.description: Verifies swipe up does not interact with parent or dismiss.

methods.name: testOnSwipeDown
methods.description: Verifies swipe down does not interact with parent or dismiss.

methods.name: testOnPinch
methods.description: Verifies pinch gesture does not interact with parent or dismiss.

methods.name: testOnSeparate
methods.description: Verifies separate gesture does not interact with parent or dismiss.

methods.name: testOnPress
methods.description: Verifies onPress calls parent listener.

methods.name: testOnRelease
methods.description: Verifies onRelease calls parent listener.

methods.name: testOnFirstKeyDown
methods.description: Verifies onFirstDownKey calls parent listener.

methods.name: testOnGestureTypingInputStart
methods.description: Verifies gesture typing input start returns false and does not interact.

methods.name: testOnGestureTypingInput
methods.description: Verifies gesture typing input does not interact with parent or dismiss.

methods.name: testOnGestureTypingInputDone
methods.description: Verifies gesture typing input done does not interact.

methods.name: testOnLongPressDone
methods.description: Verifies onLongPressDone calls parent listener.
